value.rationale: For the canonical graph-inverse trace diagnostic on all path lengths, an exact dimension-free relative variance limit 4/5 and a sharp n/2 worst-case amplification law with equality classification quantify both Monte Carlo budget and rare extreme risk. This is a naturally motivated structural benchmark, not arbitrary finite enumeration or a claim of practical superiority to known path formulas.
